timeline.summary: ICRA's Q4FY26 monitoring report showed Asian Granito utilised ₹417.18 Cr of ₹422.17 Cr net rights issue proceeds, with ₹5 Cr unutilised.

Asian Granito India Limited’s shareholders re-appointed **Mr. Maganlal Prajapati (DIN: 00564105)** and **Mr. Kandarp Gajendra Trivedi (DIN: 00314065)** as independent directors via postal ballot on 22 May 2026, with 99.93% approval.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹538.5 Cr, net loss to shareholders ₹31.89 Cr.
Asian Granito's FY26 press release reported consolidated revenue up 8.60% to ₹1,858.06 Cr, EBITDA up 15.38% to ₹120.42 Cr and net profit up 89.69% to ₹18.74 Cr, with FY25 profit restated to ₹9.88 Cr.
On 5 June 2026, Asian Granito filed audit committee and independent directors' reports certifying the distribution of fractional share proceeds.
2026-10-15: AGL Industries approved sale of 16% stake in Allomex Steel to group entities at ₹10 per share
Asian Granito filed the statement of deviation or variation in utilization of rights issue funds for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
